subject: Maths
topic_line: Help JJ & Mikey find the treasure!
intro_voice: Hi friends! I'm JJ, and this is Mikey! Answer five questions, collect five gems, and we find the treasure! Ready? Let's go!
outro_voice: Woohoo! All five gems! You found the treasure! You're a maths superstar. See you next time!

questions.q: 3 groups of 4 apples. How many apples in all?  3 × 4 = ?
questions.voice_q: Three baskets, four apples each. What is three times four?
questions.voice_a: It's twelve! Four, eight, twelve. First gem!

questions.voice_q: Five times two. What do you get?
questions.voice_a: Ten! Two, four, six, eight, ten. That's gem two!

questions.q: 4 baskets, each has 6 mangoes. How many mangoes?  4 × 6 = ?
questions.voice_q: Four baskets, six mangoes each. Four times six?
questions.voice_a: Twenty-four! Six, twelve, eighteen, twenty-four. Gem three!
Twenty-one! Seven, fourteen, twenty-one. Gem four!

questions.q: A spider has 8 legs. How many legs do 2 spiders have?  8 × 2 = ?
questions.explain: 8 twos make 16. Two eights: 8 and 8 make 16!
questions.voice_q: A spider has eight legs. Two spiders? Eight times two.
questions.voice_a: Sixteen! Eight and eight. All five gems — treasure time!
